topic: The moment Jiraiya saw Nagato's Rinnegan and decided he was the Child of Prophecy, decades before Naruto was born
title: Jiraiya Almost Walked Away From Three Orphans
description: During the Second Shinobi World War, Jiraiya took in three orphans fleeing a battle. When a shinobi cornered them, the quiet boy's eyes turned red—the legendary Rinnegan. That moment in chapter 373 changed everything: Jiraiya decided Nagato was the real Child of Prophecy, and moved in to raise him for three straight years.
comment: Was Nagato really the Child of Prophecy, or did Jiraiya just project his hopes onto a grieving orphan?

lines.text: Jiraiya found three war orphans running from a shinobi in chapter 373, and he almost turned away.
He'd only agreed to feed them, maybe teach them to fish. Nothing more. War had taken enough from kids.
Then an enemy cornered them, and the quiet boy's eyes turned red.

shot.search: Nagato eyes turn red Rinnegan awaken
shot.fallback: young boy's eyes glowing with sudden power

lines.text: Not just red. The Rinnegan—the same eyes the Sage of the Six Paths once used to bring peace to the world.

shot.fallback: ancient eyes glowing with legendary power

lines.text: Jiraiya could have feared him. Most adults would have. Instead he knelt down and told Nagato the fight wasn't his fault.

shot.fallback: understanding mentor kneeling to comfort a child

lines.text: He told him something he genuinely believed: pain forces you to understand others, if you let it.
Right there, Jiraiya made his decision. This grieving, quiet boy was the Child of Prophecy.
And Jiraiya found his first Child of Prophecy in that single moment...
